population.span: The study enrolled adults with moderate to severe nonpsychotic depression and a history of nonresponse to at least two antidepressants in the current episode, with one antidepressant assessed prospectively.

endpoint.span: The primary efficacy endpoint, change from baseline to day 28 in Montgomery-Åsberg Depression Rating Scale (MADRS) score, was assessed by a mixed-effects model using repeated measures.

analysis_set.span: Full analysis set (FAS) defined as all randomized participants who received at least 1 dose of intranasal study medication, 1 dose of oral antidepressant (AD) medication during double-blind induction phase (D-BIP).

treatment_strategy.span: Confirmed nonresponders were randomly assigned to treatment with esketamine nasal spray (56 or 84 mg twice weekly) and an antidepressant or antidepressant and placebo nasal spray.

follow_up.span: The primary efficacy endpoint, change from baseline to day 28 in Montgomery-Åsberg Depression Rating Scale (MADRS) score, was assessed by a mixed-effects model using repeated measures.

absent_reason: ci: The held abstracts and registry do not report a confidence interval for the observed-case raw between-arm mean difference. The reported intervals concern adjusted MMRM or ANCOVA least-square mean differences.

candidate_rejections.span: RESULT OUTCOME 0 ANALYSIS 0: groups Intranasal Esketamine (Esk) Plus Oral Antidepressant (AD), Intranasal Placebo Plus Oral AD | Difference of Least Square (LS) Means -4.0 (95% CI -7.31 to -0.64) | p =0.020 | METHOD Mixed Model for Repeated Measures
candidate_rejections.why: This adjusted MMRM estimate and CI cannot be substituted for the served observed-case raw change-score MD or its CI.

candidate_rejections.span: RESULT OUTCOME 1 ANALYSIS 0: groups Intranasal Esketamine (Esk) Plus Oral Antidepressant (AD), Intranasal Placebo Plus Oral AD | Difference of Least Square (LS) Means -3.5 (95% CI -6.67 to -0.26) | p =0.034 | METHOD ANCOVA
candidate_rejections.why: This adjusted ANCOVA estimate uses an endpoint with last observation carried forward; it is not the served observed-case raw Day-28 MD.

entry_population_matches_question.why: Enrolled adults had depression with nonresponse to at least two antidepressants, matching the question's adult treatment-resistant depression population.
entry_population_matches_question.span: The study enrolled adults with moderate to severe nonpsychotic depression and a history of nonresponse to at least two antidepressants in the current episode, with one antidepressant assessed prospectively.

notes: Registry spans support the served per-arm means, denominators and FAS definition. The registry explicitly labels outcome 0 dispersion as Standard Deviation. Its outcome heading names MMRM, while the bound measurements are per-arm descriptive values; these must remain separate from the adjusted analysis. No raw MD or CI was calculated. Setting aside reflects the missing matching CI, not rejection of the trial.
